title: The Weatherwright's Ledger
summary: The Council's own copy, lent to the library in good faith. — Office of Works

pages.text: A ring round the moon {~with three stars inside it~}: rain in three days. {~Count the stars, not the ring.~}
Hang the {?ombrewort?} {~in a north window~}. It curls before a storm and {~lies flat before fair~}.
For a dry district: ring the bowl, {~pour the water back to the sky~}. Ask for no more than {~a day's worth~}.
{~Build the cloud from the ground upward~}. It will break {~where you point~}, and {~what is under it~} will not stand.
pages.authorNote: Outlier. The councillor's temptation; his outcomes are all silent.

pages.text: Keep the ledger daily {~in the same ink~}. After a year {~the weather writes itself~}.
